Rig Veda 1.164.1

< Previous | Next >

Sanskrit text [Accents, Plain, Transliterated]:

अ॒स्य वा॒मस्य॑ पलि॒तस्य॒ होतु॒स्तस्य॒ भ्राता॑ मध्य॒मो अ॒स्त्यश्नः॑ ।

अस्य वामस्य पलितस्य होतुस्तस्य भ्राता मध्यमो अस्त्यश्नः ।

apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānam ā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam

English translation:

“I have beheld the Lord of men with seven sons; of which delightful and benevolent (deity), who is the object of our invocation, there is an all-pervading middle brother, and a third brother, well fed with (oblations of) ghee.”

Commentary by Sāyaṇa: Ṛgveda-bhāṣya

The seven sons are the seven solar rays; Āditya is the seventh son of Aditi.

Vāyu and Agni are spoken of as the younger brothers, the middle and the third.

Details:

Ṛṣi (sage): dīrghatamā aucathyaḥ; Devatā (deity): viśvedevā; Chandas (meter): virāṭtrisṭup;

Padapatha [Accents, Plain, Transliterated]:

अ॒स्य । वा॒मस्य॑ । प॒लि॒तस्य॑ ।
